title: FoodSafety.gov: Bag Lunches for School and Work
text: Bacteria that cause food poisoning grow rapidly at temperatures between 40°F (4°C) and 140°F (60°C). To make sure perishable lunches and snacks are safe, pack them with two cold sources. Store them in a refrigerator or cooler on arrival, if one is available.
provenance: 本轮web.run打开官方网页，Bag Lunches for School and Work连续原文，第34—40行。
applicability: 易腐午餐；到达后的冷藏/冷藏箱，不能把普通袋当冷藏箱。
